steps.title: 1. Check a text
steps.body: Paste a passage or scan a photo, then tap Check text.

steps.title: 2. Explore a word
steps.body: Tap a word for its details and related forms.

steps.title: 3. Mark words to explain
steps.body: Choose May need explaining for words your class needs help with.

steps.title: 4. Save and copy
steps.body: Tap Add. Open Selected words to add notes or copy your list.

example.sentence: Some students felt stressed before the test.
example.body: Paste this in Check a text, then tap stressed in the results.

columns: Word / word form
One spelling, such as stressed. Textbook and grade information applies to that spelling.
Word family
Related forms, such as stress, stressed and stressful. Their meanings can differ.
All word forms / Generally familiar forms
All word forms searches the full database. Generally familiar forms is a smaller set estimated to be familiar in general English. Your class may know different words.
90% / 95% lists
These lists covered at least 90% or 95% of words in each of the study’s four Hong Kong text collections, counting repeats. Your passage may differ. The 95% list includes the 90% list.
Overall family rank
Compares how common word families are in British, American and Hong Kong English. Rank 1 is highest.
HK family rank / band
Compares word families using Hong Kong school materials, speech and writing (ICE-HK), web texts (GloWbE-HK) and news (NOW-HK). A band is a range of ranks, such as 1–1,000.
First seen in HK textbooks
The earliest level where this spelling appears in the textbooks we checked. P means Primary and S means Secondary. Students may learn it at a different level.
US grade reference
A US grade reference. Choose what suits your class.
Academic Word List (AWL)
Whether this spelling has an Academic Word List record.
Middle School Vocabulary List (MSVL)
Subject-list records for this spelling, such as Science or Health.
Greek/Latin root / Root meaning
A Greek or Latin part of a word and what that part means.
Prefix / Suffix
Recorded parts at the start or end of the word.
Sort related words
Sorts by how often each spelling appears in Hong Kong speech, writing and web texts (ICE-HK and GloWbE-HK). The word you searched for stays first.
View / Add
View opens the details. Add saves that spelling in Selected words.
A dash means no information is shown for that field. A zero means none were counted.
features: Describe the words you need. Review the search, then show the results. Needs internet.
The sight-word list (CPB100) adds an underline. HK family rank adds colour. A word can have both marks.
Find words and their sentences under More text tools → All word results.
See one example per word family. Mark Known or May need explaining.
Get a rough idea of how easy your passage may be to read.
Go to Menu → Offline use and download while online. Wait for it to finish, then reopen HK-ELE.
Tap Rate this word or Report a problem, then submit the form.
